title: The Paris band and the vibraphone problem
summary: Jesse Powell goes to Paris instead of Milt Jackson because the vibes could not be shipped.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So this band you had with the Heath Brothers... It had Jesse Powell on tenor?

Yeah. Well, Jesse was used on it because Milt couldn't pay for his vibes to be shipped to Paris. Instead of going over there and renting some, we didn't think about that, you know... I told Milt, "Well, if they won't pay your transportation for the vibes, I can't take you, because I can't afford to pay for the vibes." Had we known, we could have rented some from over there, and we could have still took the band intact. But I wasn't thinking too bright, I guess, in those days. I know Milt wasn't thinking at all. It was his gig to go, and he couldn't figure out a way how he could get there. All he had to was say, "Well, I'll rent a pair when I get over there," which would have been very logical, and then we could have got there with (?) parts, because I had to fix
Jesse's parts so he could play with us, and rehearse and all that... That wouldn't have been necessary with Bags.
But anyway, we went to Paris, and that was...
That was your first trip overseas.
